summary: Evaluated studio communications split: PostgreSQL authoritative transactional state and department inboxes, GitHub minimal verified status and durable evidence, Google Drive canonical long-form human-readable briefings and reports. Recommended document-level single-writer gateway leases for department heads/authorized seniors, multiple readers, versioned URI/hash/revision references and cache-aware reads; no source, Drive, branch or configuration mutations.
